jei.destroy_extras.etching_bath.absorpti: The south port accepts 25 mB of pure HCl and the east port 250 mB of water. The bath atomically produces 275 mB of HCl solution for FeCl₂ electrolysis. The north port outputs spent etchant; the remaining ports carry the working FeCl₃ solution.

tooltip.destroy_extras.etching.mixer: A 16+ RPM Create mixer above reduces etching from 400 to 200 ticks
destroy_extras.ponder.industrial_electro: Two Create tank compartments separate the circuits. Install the controller and pump in the copper divider.
Supply 300 V / 8 A EE and at least 16 RPM to the pump. H₂, Cl₂ and NaOH stay separate; any full output stops the whole unit.
